page.overview:
What is Swords of Justice?

The Swords of Justice is a quartet consisting of three Legendary Pokémon and a Mythical Pokémon. They were introduced in Generation V and are native to the Unova region.

{| class="article-table" style="width:75%" ! style="width:5%" | Pokédex number ! Image ! Pokémon ! Type

The Swords of Justice exist to protect Pokémon that have lost their homes to humans. Cobalion is the group's leader, and Keldeo is the youngest member and apprentice. When the trio teach Keldeo the move Secret Sword, it changes into its Resolute Forme. None of the other Swords of Justice have an alternate forme.

Three Paradox Pokémon based on the original Swords of Justice trio were introduced in Generation IX, and each one's name starts with "Iron." Iron Crown is based on Cobalion, Iron Boulder is based on Terrakion, and Iron Leaves is based on Virizion.
